blueprints.name: Omniverse DSX Blueprint for AI Factory Digital Twins
blueprints.description: Design, simulate, and optimize physical infrastructure using digital twins built on NVIDIA Omniverse. Combines real-time sensor data, physics simulation, and AI to mirror real-world environments.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Creates a live digital replica of physical facilities or infrastructure. Integrates sensor feeds, CAD/BIM data, and AI models to simulate operations, test changes, and predict failures before they happen in the real world.

detail_in_practice.default: Organizations use digital twins to reduce unplanned downtime, optimize energy use, and rehearse emergency scenarios without touching production systems.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies use this to model capitol campuses, correctional facilities, and DOT asset networks — enabling maintenance planning, energy optimization, and emergency simulation without physical disruption.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Utilities model generation facilities and grid infrastructure to predict failures, optimize dispatch, and simulate storm response before it happens.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Manufacturers build digital replicas of production lines to test layout changes, predict maintenance needs, and optimize throughput without stopping operations.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Omniverse Enterprise, Isaac Sim, high-memory GPU nodes (H100/B200 recommended for real-time simulation), high-bandwidth sensor data ingestion pipeline.

blueprints.name: Retail Agentic Commerce Blueprint
blueprints.description: Reference implementation of the Agentic Commerce Protocol enabling AI-powered checkout negotiation and transaction completion while maintaining merchant control.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys AI agents that can negotiate terms, process transactions, and complete commerce workflows autonomously — operating within merchant-defined rules and guardrails.

detail_in_practice.default: Retailers and B2B sellers use this to enable AI-assisted purchasing experiences where agents can handle negotiation, upsell, and checkout on behalf of buyers or sellers.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Automates buyer-seller negotiation in B2B wholesale — agents handle volume pricing, contract terms, and order confirmation without manual back-and-forth.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: Adapted for state procurement — AI agents assist procurement officers in bid evaluation, vendor negotiation, and contract term comparison.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM microservices, LangGraph or CrewAI orchestration, low-latency GPU inference for real-time negotiation response.

blueprints.name: Nemotron Voice Agent Blueprint
blueprints.description: End-to-end voice agent built on NVIDIA Nemotron models with real-time speech-to-text, reasoning, and text-to-speech — enabling natural, low-latency voice interactions.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys a fully on-premises voice agent capable of understanding natural speech, reasoning over organizational knowledge, and responding in real time — with the option to self-host so sensitive conversations remain within the organization's controlled environment.

detail_in_practice.default: Organizations replace or augment phone-based contact centers with AI voice agents that handle routine inquiries 24/7, reducing cost-per-contact and wait times.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies deploy voice agents for high-volume citizen call centers — DMV renewals, unemployment status, benefits eligibility — deflecting routine calls around the clock.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Health systems use voice agents for appointment scheduling, prescription refill requests, and post-discharge care check-ins with a self-hosted deployment option for organizations that need to keep PHI within their controlled environment.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks and insurers handle account inquiries, claims status, and fraud alerts via voice agents that authenticate callers and resolve tier-1 issues instantly.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Riva ASR/TTS, Nemotron reasoning model via NIM, real-time inference GPU (L40S or H100 recommended), telephony integration layer.

blueprints.name: Intent-Driven RAN Energy Efficiency Blueprint
blueprints.description: Closed-loop agentic workflow that autonomously optimizes energy consumption across radio access networks and physical infrastructure by continuously monitoring and adjusting configuration parameters.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: An AI agent continuously monitors energy consumption patterns across networked infrastructure and autonomously adjusts configuration parameters to minimize usage while maintaining performance SLAs.

detail_in_practice.default: Facilities and network operations teams use this to drive down energy spend and meet sustainability mandates without manual monitoring.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Grid operators and telcos optimize power consumption across distributed network infrastructure automatically, reducing OpEx and carbon footprint.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State facilities offices deploy this across state-owned buildings and data centers to hit sustainability mandates and reduce utility spend without manual intervention.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM microservices, agentic orchestration framework, real-time telemetry ingestion, integration with building management or network management systems.

blueprints.name: Multi-Agent Intelligent Warehouse Blueprint
blueprints.description: Multi-agent AI system for warehouse operations — handles inventory monitoring, task assignment, real-time exception handling, and natural language interaction for staff.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys coordinated AI agents that monitor warehouse inventory in real time, assign tasks to workers or robots, flag exceptions, and respond to natural language queries from floor staff.

detail_in_practice.default: Distribution centers use this to reduce pick errors, improve throughput, and give floor managers real-time visibility without custom WMS development.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Retailers optimize fulfillment center operations — agents coordinate pick-pack-ship workflows, handle returns exceptions, and surface inventory discrepancies automatically.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies adapt this for emergency supply depots, evidence storage facilities, and corrections inventory — real-time tracking with natural language queries for staff.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM microservices, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph or CrewAI), computer vision NIMs for visual inventory, integration with WMS/ERP systems.

blueprints.name: Retail Catalog Enrichment Blueprint
blueprints.description: GenAI system that enriches product or service catalog entries with rich text, imagery, localized descriptions, and structured attributes — at scale and without manual copywriting.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Uses vision language models and generative AI to automatically generate product descriptions, extract structured attributes, create localized content, and produce lifestyle imagery from basic product photos.

detail_in_practice.default: E-commerce and catalog teams use this to scale content production without proportional headcount growth — enriching thousands of SKUs in the time it used to take to do dozens.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Retailers automatically generate localized product descriptions, extract searchable attributes, and create on-brand marketing copy from a single product image.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies adapt this to enrich multilingual service catalogs — generating localized benefit program descriptions and eligibility summaries for diverse citizen populations.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Nemotron VLM via NIM, diffusion model NIM for imagery, Nemotron LLM for text generation, scalable batch inference infrastructure.

blueprints.name: AI Model Distillation for Financial Data Blueprint
blueprints.description: Distills and deploys compact, domain-specific AI models from unstructured financial data — generating high-quality market signals or fiscal intelligence at lower inference cost.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Takes a large foundation model and distills it into a smaller, domain-tuned model trained on organizational financial data — achieving high accuracy at a fraction of the inference cost of a general-purpose LLM.

detail_in_practice.default: Finance teams use distilled models to generate market signals, fiscal summaries, and risk assessments from internal data without sending sensitive financials to cloud APIs.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Asset managers and banks create proprietary signal-generation models trained on their own trading data, news feeds, and financial filings — running entirely on-premises.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State budget offices distill models from appropriations history, revenue data, and economic indicators to generate fiscal intelligence for analysts without cloud data exposure.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NeMo distillation pipeline, NIM for inference, GPU cluster for training (H100/B200), data curation and annotation tooling.

blueprints.name: Quantitative Portfolio Optimization Blueprint
blueprints.description: GPU-accelerated quantitative optimization of investment portfolios — enables real-time rebalancing, risk-adjusted return optimization, and scenario analysis at institutional scale.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Applies GPU-parallelized optimization algorithms to portfolio construction — solving large-scale mean-variance, factor-based, and scenario-constrained optimization problems orders of magnitude faster than CPU-based approaches.

detail_in_practice.default: Quantitative investment teams use GPU acceleration to run optimization workloads in real time that previously required overnight batch runs.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Hedge funds and asset managers run intraday portfolio rebalancing, stress testing, and factor exposure optimization at speeds that enable true real-time risk management.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State pension funds and treasury offices optimize fund allocations and run scenario analysis on GPU infrastructure — dramatically accelerating what were previously overnight batch jobs.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA cuOpt, RAPIDS libraries, high-memory GPU nodes (A100/H100), integration with portfolio management and risk systems.

blueprints.name: Cosmos Dataset Search Blueprint
blueprints.description: Accelerates post-training of autonomous vehicle and robotics stacks using vector search and retrieval over large video datasets — enabling efficient identification of edge cases and training examples.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Uses vector search over massive video datasets to find semantically similar scenarios — enabling AV and robotics teams to surface rare edge cases, curate training data, and accelerate model iteration without manually reviewing petabytes of footage.

detail_in_practice.default: Autonomous systems teams use this to find the needle-in-a-haystack failure scenarios that matter most for safety — without watching every hour of footage.
detail_in_practice.transportation-logistics: Fleet operators and AV developers search video archives to find specific road conditions, near-miss events, or environmental edge cases for model retraining.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State DOT agencies post-train inspection drone models by searching video archives for specific bridge conditions, road defects, or infrastructure anomalies.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Cosmos tokenizer, vector database (Milvus or pgvector), GPU-accelerated embedding generation, large-scale video storage.

blueprints.name: Ambient Healthcare Agents Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI agents for clinical environments covering both provider-side (ambient documentation, clinical note generation) and patient-side (care navigation, medication adherence, post-discharge support) workflows.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys AI agents that listen to clinical conversations, generate structured clinical notes, surface relevant patient history, and assist patients with care navigation — reducing administrative burden on clinicians.

detail_in_practice.default: Health systems deploy ambient AI for two audiences: clinicians get real-time transcription and structured note generation during encounters; patients receive proactive navigation support for appointments, medication adherence, and post-discharge care guidance.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Hospitals deploy provider agents to reduce charting burden — notes generated during the visit, not after hours. Patient agents handle appointment reminders, medication coaching, and post-discharge follow-up without additional staff.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State correctional health and state hospital clinicians use ambient documentation to meet charting standards. State Medicaid programs deploy patient agents to guide beneficiaries through care navigation and benefits questions.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Riva ASR, Nemotron reasoning model via NIM, EHR integration layer, self-hosted deployment option for organizations seeking greater control over PHI handling.

blueprints.name: Flood Intelligence Blueprint (H2O.ai)
blueprints.description: Real-time AI-powered disaster risk intelligence — flood prediction, severity mapping, and emergency response coordination at scale using geospatial and sensor data.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Combines geospatial data, weather models, and sensor feeds to generate real-time flood risk predictions, severity maps, and emergency response recommendations — enabling proactive rather than reactive disaster management.

detail_in_practice.default: Emergency management and infrastructure teams use this to predict flood impact before it happens and pre-position resources accordingly.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State emergency management agencies use real-time flood modeling to pre-position equipment, coordinate mutual aid, and brief governors before events peak.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Utilities predict flooding impact on substations, generation facilities, and distribution infrastructure — enabling pre-emptive grid hardening and crew staging.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: H2O.ai Driverless AI, NVIDIA GPU-accelerated geospatial processing, real-time sensor data ingestion, GIS integration.

blueprints.name: Cyborg Enterprise RAG Blueprint
blueprints.description: Secure multimodal RAG with encryption-in-use — extract, embed, and index sensitive documents while keeping data encrypted throughout the retrieval and inference pipeline.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Enables retrieval-augmented generation over sensitive document corpora while keeping all data encrypted — supporting compliance requirements in highly regulated environments that cannot use standard RAG pipelines.

detail_in_practice.default: Regulated organizations use encrypted RAG to unlock the value of sensitive document archives while helping address data-protection requirements.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Health systems query clinical records, treatment protocols, and research data through encrypted RAG — PHI stays encrypted even during inference.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State law enforcement and child welfare agencies query sensitive case files and court records through encrypted RAG without data ever leaving the secure environment unprotected.
detail_in_practice.legal-services: Law firms query privileged documents, case files, and contracts through encrypted retrieval — supporting confidentiality controls.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: Cyborg encryption-in-use layer, NVIDIA NIM for embedding and inference, on-premises vector database, air-gap capable deployment.

blueprints.name: Retail Shopping Assistant Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI-powered shopping advisor with multi-agent architecture, real-time streaming responses, image-based product search, and intelligent cart management.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys a conversational shopping agent that understands natural language requests, searches product catalogs by image or text, makes personalized recommendations, and manages cart state across a session.

detail_in_practice.default: Retailers use this to provide expert shopping assistance at scale — replacing or augmenting human associates for product discovery and purchase decisions.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: E-commerce and in-store kiosk deployments provide expert product guidance, compare alternatives, and guide customers through complex purchases.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: Adapted as a citizen benefits discovery assistant — guides residents through available programs, eligibility requirements, and application steps conversationally.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM LLM and embedding models, LangGraph agent orchestration, vector search for catalog retrieval, real-time streaming inference.

blueprints.name: Streaming Data to RAG Blueprint
blueprints.description: Connects real-time streaming data sources — sensors, radio feeds, operational systems — to a RAG pipeline, enabling AI queries over live data rather than static document snapshots.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Ingests streaming data from sensors, APIs, and operational systems, continuously indexes it into a vector store, and exposes it through a RAG interface — enabling AI queries that reflect the current state of operations, not yesterday's data.

detail_in_practice.default: Operations teams use streaming RAG to ask natural language questions about live operational data — 'What's the status of line 3 right now?' — without writing SQL queries.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Grid operators query live SCADA, sensor, and weather data through natural language to support real-time situational awareness and outage response.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: Emergency operations centers ingest live sensor, radio, and field data into a RAG pipeline — dispatchers and commanders can query current field conditions in natural language.
detail_in_practice.oil-gas: Upstream operators query live drilling telemetry, well pressure, and equipment sensor data through natural language for real-time operational intelligence.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: Kafka or Pulsar streaming, NVIDIA NIM embedding models, vector database with continuous upsert, NIM LLM for query reasoning.

blueprints.name: Multi-LLM NIM Blueprint
blueprints.description: Deploy a broad range of open-source and custom LLMs through a unified NIM container interface — enabling organizations to run and serve multiple models on-premises without cloud dependency.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides a standardized container runtime for deploying any Hugging Face or custom LLM with NIM's optimized inference stack — consistent API surface, GPU optimization, and enterprise support regardless of which model is running.

detail_in_practice.default: IT and platform teams use this to build a sovereign AI model serving layer — any team in the organization can access models through a standard API without each team managing their own inference infrastructure.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense organizations run classified-environment LLMs entirely on-premises through a unified serving layer — no model weights or queries leave the secure enclave.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State DoIT teams build a shared model serving platform that any agency can call — centralized governance, decentralized access, no cloud data exposure.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM container runtime, GPU cluster (any modern NVIDIA data center GPU), Kubernetes or on-prem orchestration, model registry.

blueprints.name: Biomedical AI-Q Research Agent Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI agents for biomedical research — literature search, virtual screening, protein-ligand interaction analysis, and hypothesis generation using AI-Q and BioNeMo.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Combines AI-Q agentic reasoning with BioNeMo molecular models to enable researchers to query biomedical literature, screen molecular candidates, analyze protein interactions, and generate research hypotheses — accelerating drug discovery and disease research cycles.

detail_in_practice.default: Life sciences research teams use this to compress months of literature review and early-stage screening into days.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Pharmaceutical and biotech companies accelerate early-stage drug discovery — agents search literature, screen millions of molecular candidates, and surface the most promising leads.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State public health labs use AI-assisted genomic surveillance to detect disease outbreaks, identify pathogen variants, and generate research briefs faster than manual analysis allows.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs, AI-Q orchestration framework, high-memory GPU nodes for molecular simulation, biomedical vector database.

blueprints.name: AI Observability for Data Flywheel Blueprint (W&B)
blueprints.description: Streamlines evaluation, monitoring, and continuous optimization of AI models in production — tracking performance, detecting drift, and logging experiments through Weights & Biases integration.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Integrates Weights & Biases observability into the NVIDIA data flywheel — tracking model performance metrics, experiment results, drift signals, and retraining triggers across all production AI models in a unified dashboard.

detail_in_practice.default: AI platform and data science teams use this to maintain visibility and control over every model in production — catching degradation before it reaches users.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Risk and compliance teams use model observability to demonstrate that AI-driven decisions remain accurate and auditable over time — satisfying regulatory model risk management requirements.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State AI governance offices monitor deployed models — benefits eligibility, fraud detection — for drift and bias, ensuring ongoing fairness and accuracy.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: Weights & Biases platform, NVIDIA NeMo evaluator, GPU-accelerated evaluation pipeline, model registry with lineage tracking.

blueprints.name: AI Orchestration for Data Flywheel Blueprint
blueprints.description: Orchestrates the full AI data flywheel lifecycle — data ingestion, curation, model training, evaluation, and deployment — using MLRun and NVIDIA NeMo microservices.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides end-to-end MLOps orchestration — automates the pipeline from raw data ingestion through curation, training, evaluation, and deployment, with human feedback loops baked in to continuously improve models.

detail_in_practice.default: ML platform teams use this to replace fragile hand-built pipelines with a governed, automated flywheel that keeps all production models improving over time.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Health AI teams automate retraining of clinical models as new patient data accumulates — keeping diagnostic and triage models current without manual intervention.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State IT offices run automated retraining pipelines for fraud detection, benefits eligibility, and recidivism risk models — keeping them accurate as population and policy shifts.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: Iguazio MLRun platform, NVIDIA NeMo microservices, GPU cluster for training, data lake or lakehouse integration.

blueprints.name: Safety for Agentic AI Blueprint
blueprints.description: Comprehensive safety, security, and privacy framework for agentic AI systems — covering guardrails, access control, content safety, privacy preservation, and audit logging.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides a reference architecture for deploying agentic AI safely — NeMo Guardrails for content and behavior control, privacy-preserving inference, access control policies, and comprehensive audit logging for compliance and forensics.

detail_in_practice.default: Organizations use this as the safety layer underneath every AI agent deployment — ensuring agents can't be manipulated, can't access data beyond their authorization, and leave a complete audit trail.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks and insurers deploy AI agents with guardrails that prevent unauthorized data access, enforce regulatory boundaries, and log every agent action for examiner review.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State governments use this as their AI governance foundation — ensuring every deployed AI system is explainable, privacy-preserving, and compliant with state AI legislation.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, NIM microservices, policy engine integration, audit logging infrastructure, RBAC integration.

blueprints.name: AI Agent for Telecom Network Configuration Planning Blueprint
blueprints.description: Agentic AI framework for automating and optimizing radio access network (RAN) parameter configuration — using LLM-driven reasoning to tune network performance continuously.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys an AI agent that continuously monitors RAN performance metrics and autonomously adjusts configuration parameters — replacing the manual, expert-intensive process of network optimization.

detail_in_practice.default: Telecom network operations teams use this to reduce the manual effort of RAN parameter tuning while improving network performance consistency.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State broadband offices and public safety network operators use this to optimize FirstNet and rural broadband network performance without requiring dedicated RF engineering staff.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense communications teams apply this to tactical and base network optimization — maintaining performance under variable conditions autonomously.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM LLM microservices, RAN telemetry integration, agentic orchestration framework, network management system APIs.

blueprints.name: Financial Fraud Detection Blueprint
blueprints.description: Real-time AI fraud detection for financial transaction data — identifies sophisticated fraud patterns with high accuracy using GPU-accelerated graph analytics and ML models.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Applies GPU-accelerated graph analytics and ensemble ML models to transaction streams in real time — detecting fraud rings, account takeover, synthetic identity fraud, and insider threats faster and more accurately than rule-based systems.

detail_in_practice.default: Finance and risk teams use this to catch fraud at the point of transaction rather than in next-day batch review — reducing losses and false positives simultaneously.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks and payment processors detect card fraud, account takeover, and wire fraud in milliseconds using GPU-accelerated pattern recognition across transaction graphs.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies apply this to Medicaid fraud, unemployment insurance fraud, tax evasion, and procurement irregularities — turning reactive investigation into real-time detection.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Health systems detect billing fraud, duplicate claims, and inappropriate prescribing patterns across payer and provider networks.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA RAPIDS graph analytics, cuML fraud models, GPU-accelerated feature engineering, real-time transaction stream integration.

blueprints.name: NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint for Intelligent Agents
blueprints.description: Foundational agentic AI infrastructure — connects AI agents to enterprise data sources, enables multi-step reasoning, and delivers trusted, actionable insights across organizational knowledge.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides the reasoning, retrieval, and orchestration foundation for enterprise AI agents — connects to databases, document stores, APIs, and structured data sources, then reasons across them to answer complex multi-step questions.

detail_in_practice.default: Platform and IT teams deploy AI-Q as the core intelligence layer that all business-specific agents are built on top of — reducing the work of building each new agent from scratch.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State DoIT offices deploy AI-Q as the foundational platform that agency-specific agents run on — a shared infrastructure investment that multiplies as each new agency use case comes online.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Health systems use AI-Q as the connective tissue between clinical systems, protocols, and research data — powering agents that reason across the full knowledge base rather than a single system.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM LLM and embedding microservices, NeMo Retriever, multi-agent orchestration, enterprise data connectors, vector database.

blueprints.name: AI Weather Analytics with Earth-2 Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI-powered weather analysis and forecasting with multi-layered geospatial visualization — enables high-resolution atmospheric modeling and environmental intelligence at regional and global scale.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Runs GPU-accelerated atmospheric AI models — including NVIDIA FourCastNet and Pangu-Weather — to generate high-resolution forecasts, visualize multi-layered geospatial data, and support environmental analysis at speeds unachievable with traditional NWP.

detail_in_practice.default: Operations and planning teams use Earth-2 to make weather-informed decisions faster and at higher resolution than public forecast services allow.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Grid operators use high-resolution wind and solar forecasting to optimize generation dispatch and anticipate demand spikes more accurately than 24-hour public forecasts.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: Emergency management agencies use Earth-2 to generate hyperlocal severe weather and flood forecasts — enabling earlier evacuation decisions and more precise resource pre-positioning.
detail_in_practice.oil-gas: Offshore operators use high-resolution sea-state and storm forecasting to make production continuation and evacuation decisions days earlier than before.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Earth-2 platform, FourCastNet / Pangu-Weather AI models via NIM, GPU cluster for inference, geospatial visualization stack.

blueprints.name: NVIDIA RAG Blueprint

detail_in_practice.default: Every knowledge-intensive organization uses RAG to make institutional knowledge queryable — the building block underneath most enterprise AI assistant deployments.

detail_in_practice.legal-services: Law firms and legal departments query contracts, precedents, and regulatory filings — finding relevant clauses and cases in seconds rather than hours.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies make statutes, administrative code, HR policy, and procurement rules instantly queryable by employees — eliminating the 'who knows where that policy lives?' problem.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Finance teams query earnings transcripts, risk reports, and regulatory filings in natural language — accelerating research and compliance review.

detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State police and corrections agencies search body cam and facility surveillance footage for specific events — dramatically reducing evidence review time for investigations.
detail_in_practice.transportation-logistics: Fleet operators and port authorities detect incidents, safety violations, and cargo exceptions across camera networks without requiring 24/7 human monitoring.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Plant operations teams detect quality defects, safety violations, and process anomalies in production line camera feeds in real time.

detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Product designers iterate on physical product aesthetics using AI generation guided by CAD geometry — maintaining dimensional accuracy while exploring design variations rapidly.

detail_in_practice.state-local-government: Infrastructure planners visualize proposed road, building, or facility designs in context — AI-generated renderings guided by survey and GIS geometry.

blueprints.name: PDF to Podcast Blueprint

detail_in_practice.default: Communications and learning teams use this to make dense content more accessible — employees actually consume audio briefings during commutes rather than ignoring PDF attachments.
detail_in_practice.education: Universities convert course materials, research papers, and reading lists into audio for students who prefer listening — improving engagement with dense academic content.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: Legislative staff, agency communicators, and field employees convert budget documents, policy updates, and regulatory guidance into audio briefings consumable during travel.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Clinical education teams convert clinical protocols, drug formulary updates, and training materials into audio for staff who can't pause patient care to read.

blueprints.name: AI Virtual Assistant for Customer Service Blueprint
blueprints.description: Customizable AI virtual assistant for customer service — handles common inquiries, routes complex issues, and maintains contextually aware conversations across channels.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys a text-based AI assistant that handles tier-1 and tier-2 inquiries, maintains conversation context, integrates with backend systems for live data, and escalates intelligently to human agents when needed.

detail_in_practice.default: Customer-facing teams use this to deflect high-volume routine inquiries — reducing cost-per-contact and wait times while freeing human agents for complex issues.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agency portals deploy virtual assistants for citizen services — answering questions about benefits, licenses, permits, and applications without requiring a phone call.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Patient portals deploy AI assistants for scheduling, prescription refills, and benefit coverage questions — reducing call center volume significantly.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks and insurers handle account inquiries, policy questions, and claim status without live agent involvement for the majority of contacts.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM LLM and embedding, LangGraph agent orchestration, CRM/backend API integration, real-time streaming response.

blueprints.name: Single-Cell Analysis with RAPIDS Blueprint
blueprints.description: GPU-accelerated single-cell RNA and DNA sequencing analysis — dramatically speeds up the processing and analysis of large single-cell datasets for genomics research.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Applies GPU-parallelized RAPIDS algorithms to single-cell sequencing data — reducing analysis time from hours or days to minutes for standard scRNA-seq workflows, enabling researchers to iterate faster.

detail_in_practice.default: Genomics research teams use GPU acceleration to process single-cell datasets at speeds that make iterative, exploratory analysis practical rather than bottlenecked.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Biotech and pharma researchers analyze tumor microenvironments, cell type compositions, and gene expression at single-cell resolution — with results in minutes rather than overnight.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State public health labs apply GPU-accelerated genomics to disease surveillance — processing pathogen sequencing data fast enough to inform real-time outbreak response.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA RAPIDS (cuDF, cuML, cuGraph), high-memory GPU nodes (A100/H100), Jupyter or pipeline integration for genomics workflows.

blueprints.name: BioNeMo Protein Engineering Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI-assisted protein structure prediction, binding site analysis, and protein-ligand interaction modeling using NVIDIA BioNeMo generative and predictive models.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Applies BioNeMo protein language models to predict protein structures, model binding interactions, design protein binders, and screen candidate compounds — compressing early-stage drug discovery and bioengineering research cycles.

detail_in_practice.default: Life sciences research teams use this to screen molecular candidates and design protein binders computationally before committing to expensive wet lab synthesis.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Biotech and pharma teams use protein engineering AI to design novel therapeutics, predict antibody binding, and identify enzyme engineering targets.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agriculture and public health labs use protein and pathogen modeling to analyze disease-causing organisms and food safety threats faster than traditional lab methods.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs (ESMFold, MolMIM, DiffDock), high-memory GPU nodes for molecular simulation.

blueprints.name: Enterprise Data Flywheel Core Blueprint
blueprints.description: Core infrastructure for building a continuous AI improvement loop — data ingestion, curation, synthetic data generation, model fine-tuning, and evaluation, powered by NVIDIA NeMo.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides the foundational infrastructure for organizations to continuously improve their AI models using operational data — automating data curation, synthetic augmentation, fine-tuning, and evaluation in a governed loop.

detail_in_practice.default: AI platform teams use this as the engine under all their production models — ensuring every model improves over time as new data accumulates, without requiring a full retraining project each time.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Trading and risk teams build proprietary model improvement loops — each new market event becomes training signal that automatically improves the next model generation.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State AI programs use this as the infrastructure backbone — every agency AI use case feeds back into a governed improvement loop maintained centrally by DoIT.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NeMo Curator, NeMo Customizer, synthetic data generation pipeline, GPU cluster for training (H100/B200), model registry with lineage.

blueprints.name: Securing Agentic AI Blueprint
blueprints.description: Security hardening framework for agentic AI systems — covers prompt injection defense, access control, tool use boundaries, audit logging, and red-teaming for production agent deployments.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides reference architectures and implementation guides for hardening AI agent systems against adversarial manipulation, unauthorized data access, and tool misuse — with built-in audit logging satisfying enterprise and regulatory security requirements.

detail_in_practice.default: Security and AI platform teams use this to ensure every deployed agent has defensible access controls, tamper-resistant audit trails, and tested defenses against prompt injection.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks use this to ensure AI agents handling transactions cannot be manipulated into unauthorized transfers and leave a complete audit trail for regulators.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State CISO offices use this as the security framework that AI deployments must pass before production — ensuring agents accessing sensitive citizen data are hardened and auditable.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, RBAC and policy enforcement layer, audit logging infrastructure, red-teaming tooling.

blueprints.name: Vulnerability Analysis Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI-accelerated container and software vulnerability scanning — uses generative AI to rapidly identify, triage, and explain security vulnerabilities across containerized infrastructure.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Scans container images and software dependencies for known CVEs, uses AI to triage severity in context, and generates natural language remediation guidance — accelerating the vulnerability management cycle dramatically.

detail_in_practice.default: Security and DevSecOps teams use AI-accelerated scanning to process vulnerability backlogs faster and get actionable remediation guidance without manually researching each CVE.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense IT teams achieve continuous ATO compliance by running automated vulnerability scanning with AI-generated remediation plans that meet STIG and RMF requirements.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State CISO offices use AI-accelerated scanning across state-hosted container workloads — surfacing the highest-priority vulnerabilities with remediation guidance for resource-constrained security teams.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM LLM for analysis, container scanning integration (Trivy or equivalent), CVE database feeds, CI/CD pipeline integration.

blueprints.name: Digital Human Blueprint
blueprints.description: Interactive AI-powered digital human for real-time, face-to-face style conversational interactions — combining avatar rendering, voice, and reasoning for kiosk, web, and immersive deployments.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Renders a photorealistic or stylized interactive avatar that speaks, listens, and reasons in real time — providing face-to-face style conversational assistance for scenarios where a chat interface feels too impersonal.

detail_in_practice.default: Customer experience and communications teams use digital humans in kiosks, web experiences, and training scenarios where an interactive human presence matters.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Retailers deploy digital human sales associates in stores and online — providing expert, personalized assistance without requiring staff to be physically present.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies deploy digital human kiosks in high-traffic offices — DMV, social services lobbies — providing accessible, interactive guidance to walk-in citizens.
detail_in_practice.education: Universities use digital humans for interactive student onboarding, advising support, and tutoring experiences.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA ACE (Avatar Cloud Engine), Riva ASR/TTS, Nemotron reasoning model, real-time rendering GPU (RTX or L40S), avatar rendering pipeline.

blueprints.name: AI-Q Research Assistant Blueprint
blueprints.description: Deep research agent that autonomously searches, synthesizes, and summarizes information from multiple enterprise data sources — delivering comprehensive, cited research briefs on any topic.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys an AI research agent that formulates search strategies, queries multiple internal and external sources, synthesizes findings, resolves conflicts between sources, and delivers a comprehensive cited research brief — replacing hours of manual research.

detail_in_practice.default: Analysts, researchers, and decision-makers use this to compress multi-hour research tasks into minutes — with output that provides citations back to every retrieved source.
detail_in_practice.legal-services: Legal teams conduct rapid case law research, regulatory landscape analysis, and contract clause searches with AI that retrieves and cites every relevant document.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State policy analysts, budget staff, and legislative researchers use AI-Q to synthesize complex policy questions across statutes, precedents, and agency data in minutes.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Investment analysts use AI-Q to synthesize earnings transcripts, analyst reports, and proprietary data into comprehensive investment theses.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA AI-Q framework, NIM LLM and embedding, multi-source retrieval connectors, citation tracking layer, web search integration.

blueprints.name: LLM Router Blueprint
blueprints.description: Intelligently routes LLM inference requests to the most appropriate model based on query complexity, cost constraints, and performance requirements — optimizing quality and cost across a fleet of models.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Analyzes incoming LLM queries and routes them to the optimal model in the fleet — routing simple queries to efficient small models and complex reasoning to larger ones, reducing cost while maintaining quality.

detail_in_practice.default: IT and AI platform teams use LLM routing to cut inference costs significantly without degrading user experience — simple lookups hit a small model, complex analysis hits a large one.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State DoIT offices reduce AI infrastructure cost by routing the majority of routine citizen service queries to efficient small models and escalating complex multi-step queries to frontier models.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks optimize AI cost across high-volume transaction query workloads — routing simple balance inquiries to efficient models and complex risk analysis to frontier models.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM routing layer, fleet of NIM-served LLMs at varying sizes, query classification model, cost tracking integration.

blueprints.name: Genomics Analysis Blueprint
blueprints.description: GPU-accelerated genomics pipeline for large-scale DNA and RNA sequencing analysis — covering variant calling, alignment, and population-scale genomic data processing.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Accelerates the full genomics analysis pipeline using NVIDIA Parabricks — alignment, variant calling, and downstream analysis — reducing whole genome analysis from hours to minutes.

detail_in_practice.default: Genomics research and clinical labs use GPU acceleration to process sequencing data fast enough to support time-sensitive clinical decisions and large-cohort research.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Clinical genomics labs support real-time diagnosis of rare diseases, infectious disease outbreak tracking, and pharmacogenomics with whole-genome analysis in under 30 minutes.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State public health labs run GPU-accelerated genomic surveillance for infectious disease — processing pathogen sequencing data in near-real-time to inform outbreak response.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Parabricks, high-memory GPU nodes (A100/H100), genomics data pipeline, integration with LIMS and bioinformatics tools.

blueprints.name: NemoClaw for Hermes Agent Blueprint
blueprints.description: Deploy governed autonomous Hermes agents in enterprise environments — agents work with approved tools and data sources, learn team workflows, and turn repeatable guidance into durable reusable skills via NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxing.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys Hermes AI agents inside NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes — giving enterprises policy-based control over which tools, data sources, and systems agents can touch. Agents learn team workflows through real usage, capture repeatable guidance as durable Hermes Skills, and improve future performance automatically. OpenShell guardrails enforce access boundaries and data handling policies at runtime.

detail_in_practice.default: Teams deploy governed agents for tasks like PR review, incident triage, product planning, and launch review — agents learn preferred approaches from corrections and feedback, compounding value over time without retraining.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Trading ops and technology teams deploy governed agents for regulatory research, exception handling, and workflow automation — with OpenShell enforcing strict boundaries around which data and systems agents can access.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State DoIT offices deploy governed agents for cross-agency workflows — procurement review, policy research, incident triage — with OpenShell guardrails satisfying security review requirements before production.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense IT teams deploy sandboxed agents for classified-environment automation — OpenShell policy enforcement provides the access control and audit trail required for ATO and security compliance.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Nemotron models via NIM, NVIDIA OpenShell runtime (early preview), LangChain or Hermes agent harness, Hermes Skills registry, enterprise tool and data source connectors.

blueprints.name: NemoClaw for LangChain Deep Agents Blueprint
blueprints.description: Reference architecture for building long-running enterprise agents combining LangChain Deep Agents Code, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, and NVIDIA OpenShell — tuned for benchmark-leading agent performance at significantly lower inference cost.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides a fully tuned enterprise agent stack — Nemotron 3 Ultra as the open model layer, LangChain Deep Agents as the harness for planning, tool use, memory, and long-running task execution, and OpenShell as the governed runtime. The three layers are tuned together, delivering strong agent benchmark performance at a fraction of the cost of frontier API models.

detail_in_practice.default: Engineering and AI platform teams use this as the reference architecture for building production-grade agentic systems — model, harness, runtime, and eval loop all specified and tuned together rather than assembled ad hoc.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Quant and technology teams build long-running research and workflow agents that operate within OpenShell access policies — tuning harness and model together for domain-specific performance at lower inference cost than cloud APIs.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense AI teams build mission-specific agents on a fully on-premises open stack — no model weights or agent traces leave the secure environment, with OpenShell governing every tool interaction.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra via NIM, LangChain Deep Agents Code (dcode), NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, GPU cluster for inference (Blackwell recommended for cost-performance), evaluation pipeline for harness tuning.

blueprints.name: GPU Query Engine (GQE) Blueprint
blueprints.description: Reference architecture for building GPU-accelerated SQL query engines using NVIDIA GQE and libcudf — delivers up to 7.5x speedup over CPU databases on large-scale analytical workloads.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides a reference implementation for executing SQL queries at GPU-accelerated speeds over massive datasets — using NVIDIA cuDF, nvCOMP, and NVLink-C2C to move query execution from CPU to GPU. Achieves up to 7.5x aggregate speedup and up to 25.5x per-query gains on large-scale benchmarks. Open-source architecture informs database engine design for teams embedding GPU acceleration into their own analytics stacks.

detail_in_practice.default: Data and analytics teams use GQE to query datasets that are too large or too slow on CPU-based systems — eliminating overnight batch jobs or expensive cloud query costs by moving analytical workloads to on-premises GPU infrastructure.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Quant and risk teams run intraday analytical queries over transaction histories, position data, and market feeds at speeds that enable real-time risk attribution and factor analysis previously requiring overnight batch runs.
detail_in_practice.oil-gas: Reservoir engineers and production teams query decades of drilling telemetry, well logs, and sensor history in seconds — enabling iterative analysis that was previously bottlenecked by CPU query engines.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Grid analytics teams query meter, outage, and asset event histories at scale — supporting real-time operational analytics and large-cohort infrastructure modeling.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Operations and engineering teams query high-frequency production sensor data, quality records, and maintenance histories at speeds that support real-time root cause analysis on the plant floor.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA GB200 NVL4 or any modern NVIDIA data center GPU, NVIDIA cuDF and CUDA-X libraries, nvCOMP compression library, Substrait query plan integration, existing data lake or lakehouse storage.

blueprints.name: Nsight Copilot — AI Code Assistant for CUDA Development Blueprint
blueprints.description: AI-powered CUDA-aware coding assistant deployed on DGX Spark — delivers expert GPU programming chat, real-time code completion, and RAG grounded in authoritative NVIDIA GPU programming knowledge.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys a CUDA-aware AI coding assistant on DGX Spark that understands GPU programming patterns, NVIDIA APIs, and performance optimization techniques. Provides expert chat, real-time code completion, and retrieval-augmented answers grounded in NVIDIA documentation — running entirely on-premises so proprietary code never leaves the organization.

detail_in_practice.default: Engineering and HPC teams use Nsight Copilot to accelerate GPU code development — getting expert-level guidance on CUDA optimization, kernel design, and NVIDIA library usage without requiring every developer to have deep GPU expertise.
detail_in_practice.education: University HPC centers and engineering programs deploy Nsight Copilot to support researchers and students moving workloads to CUDA — reducing the expertise barrier for GPU-accelerated computational science.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense software organizations use on-premises Nsight Copilot for classified GPU development environments — expert CUDA assistance without sending proprietary code or queries to external APIs.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Manufacturers developing simulation, vision, or digital-twin code internally use Nsight Copilot to accelerate GPU optimization without building a dedicated GPU programming team.
detail_in_practice.oil-gas: Seismic processing and reservoir simulation developers use Nsight Copilot to optimize GPU kernels for high-performance geoscience computing workflows.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA DGX Spark (personal AI supercomputer), NIM microservices for LLM and embedding, RAG pipeline over NVIDIA GPU programming documentation, on-premises deployment.

blueprints.name: NemoClaw for OpenClaw Blueprint
blueprints.description: Run always-on OpenClaw agents with greater enterprise control, privacy, and flexibility — installed with a single command via NVIDIA OpenShell for sandboxed, governed agentic execution.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Extends the popular open-source OpenClaw autonomous agent framework with NVIDIA OpenShell enterprise governance — adding policy-based access control, sandboxed execution, and privacy guardrails to always-on agents. Single-command installation wraps OpenClaw agents in enterprise-grade security without requiring a full rebuild of existing agent workflows.

detail_in_practice.default: Organizations already experimenting with OpenClaw agents use this to move from prototype to production — adding the governance, access control, and audit logging required for enterprise deployment without changing the underlying agent logic.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense organizations deploy governed OpenClaw agents inside secure enclaves — OpenShell sandboxing ensures agents cannot access systems or data outside their defined authorization boundary.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks and insurers wrap existing agentic workflows in OpenShell governance — satisfying model risk management and audit requirements for AI agents operating near sensitive financial systems.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA OpenShell runtime (early preview), OpenClaw agent framework, NVIDIA NIM for model inference, policy configuration layer, on-premises or air-gapped deployment capable.

blueprints.name: Synthetic Manipulation Motion Generation for Robotics Blueprint
blueprints.description: Generate exponentially large amounts of synthetic robot manipulation training trajectories from a small number of human demonstrations — built on NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, Omniverse, and Cosmos.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Captures a small number of human task demonstrations via spatial computing device, then synthetically generates hundreds of thousands of physically accurate robot training trajectories — dramatically compressing the data acquisition bottleneck in robot learning. NVIDIA used this to generate 780,000 trajectories (equivalent to 9 months of human demonstration) in 11 hours, improving GR00T N1 performance by 40%.

detail_in_practice.default: Robotics teams use this to break the data bottleneck in robot learning — going from a handful of human demonstrations to a massive, diverse training dataset without months of additional data collection.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Manufacturers training robots for assembly, material handling, or quality inspection tasks generate synthetic trajectory datasets that would be impossible to collect through real-world teleoperation alone.
detail_in_practice.food-cpg-manufacturing: Food manufacturers developing robotic picking, packing, and palletizing automation generate diverse synthetic training data covering product variation, orientation, and handling edge cases.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: E-commerce fulfillment operators training robotic picking systems generate synthetic trajectories covering the full SKU diversity of their catalog without physically demonstrating each item handling scenario.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Defense robotics programs generate synthetic manipulation datasets for hazardous or operationally constrained scenarios that cannot be safely demonstrated repeatedly in the real world.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T-Mimic, NVIDIA Omniverse, NVIDIA Cosmos world foundation models, spatial computing device for initial demonstrations (Apple Vision Pro or equivalent), H100 GPU or higher with 80GB VRAM.

blueprints.name: Mega Blueprint — Test Multi-Robot Fleets for Industrial Automation
blueprints.description: Simulate, test, and optimize heterogeneous physical AI and robot fleets at scale in industrial digital twins before real-world deployment — built on NVIDIA Omniverse, OpenUSD, and Isaac ROS.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Builds a physics-accurate digital twin of industrial facilities — factories, warehouses, distribution centers — and simulates heterogeneous robot fleets (AMRs, humanoids, intelligent cameras, visual AI agents) operating together. Teams test fleet coordination, optimize layouts, validate performance, and catch failure modes before any robot touches the physical environment.

detail_in_practice.default: Industrial operations teams use Mega to validate robot fleet deployments digitally — catching coordination failures, layout inefficiencies, and edge cases in simulation before committing to physical deployment.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Automotive and electronics manufacturers simulate humanoid and AMR robot fleets on assembly lines — validating that robots can coordinate with human workers and each other before physical commissioning.
detail_in_practice.food-cpg-manufacturing: CPG companies simulate automated picking, packing, and palletizing robot fleets across facility layouts before physical installation — optimizing throughput and identifying congestion points digitally.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Distribution center operators simulate AMR and humanoid robot fleets across warehouse layouts — testing fleet routing, task allocation, and human-robot interaction before deployment.
detail_in_practice.transportation-logistics: Port, airport, and yard operators simulate autonomous vehicle and robot fleets in their facility digital twins — optimizing throughput and validating safety protocols before live operations.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Omniverse Enterprise, OpenUSD, Isaac ROS, Sensor RTX for sensor simulation, fleet management system integration via VDA5050, GPU cluster for real-time simulation.

blueprints.name: Digital Twin for Interactive Fluid Simulation Blueprint
blueprints.description: Real-time interactive digital twin for computational fluid dynamics and external aerodynamics — combines GPU-accelerated solvers, PhysicsNeMo AI surrogate models, and Omniverse visualization for instant engineering simulation feedback.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Provides a reference workflow for building real-time CFD digital twins — combining CUDA-X accelerated physics solvers with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo AI surrogate models to achieve up to 1,200x faster simulations and interactive visualization. Engineers can change geometry or boundary conditions and see updated flow field results in real time rather than waiting hours or days.

detail_in_practice.default: Engineering teams use interactive CFD digital twins to compress design iteration cycles from days or weeks to minutes — testing design changes and seeing fluid dynamics results instantly rather than submitting batch jobs.
detail_in_practice.general-manufacturing: Product engineers run interactive aerodynamic, thermal, and airflow simulations during design review — testing geometry changes in real time without submitting to a compute cluster queue.
detail_in_practice.oil-gas: Reservoir and facilities engineers run interactive flow simulations for pipeline design, equipment optimization, and process engineering — compressing analysis cycles that previously required dedicated HPC time.
detail_in_practice.utilities-energy: Power generation engineers simulate cooling, thermal management, and airflow for turbines, generators, and facility HVAC — enabling interactive design optimization without day-long batch runs.
detail_in_practice.federal-defense: Aerospace and naval engineering programs simulate aerodynamic and hydrodynamic performance interactively — testing propulsion, hull, and airframe design variations in real time during the design process.
detail_in_practice.education: University engineering programs give students and researchers interactive CFD simulation that previously required expensive dedicated HPC clusters — enabling hands-on fluid dynamics learning and research.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA CUDA-X accelerated solvers, NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo physics-AI framework, NVIDIA Omniverse for visualization, high-memory GPU nodes (GH200 or H100 recommended), integration with existing CAE software (Ansys, Siemens, Altair, Cadence).

blueprints.name: Evo 2 Protein Design Blueprint
blueprints.description: Generative AI workflow for designing DNA sequences that translate into proteins for bioengineering — using the Evo 2 foundation model trained on genomic data across the tree of life.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Uses the Evo 2 genomic foundation model — trained on billions of DNA sequences across the tree of life — to generate novel DNA sequences that can be translated into proteins with desired properties. Enables bioengineers and researchers to explore the sequence space of life computationally before committing to wet lab synthesis.

detail_in_practice.default: Life sciences research teams use Evo 2 to explore genomic design space computationally — generating candidate sequences for novel proteins, enzymes, and therapeutic targets without exhaustive wet lab screening.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Biopharma and biotech researchers use Evo 2 for therapeutic protein design, enzyme engineering, and functional genomics — generating and screening candidates computationally before synthesis.
detail_in_practice.food-cpg-manufacturing: Food science and agricultural biotech teams use Evo 2 for enzyme design, fermentation optimization, and crop bioengineering research.
detail_in_practice.education: Major research universities give faculty and graduate researchers access to frontier genomic AI tools for translational research and drug discovery programs.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State public health labs and agricultural agencies use Evo 2 for pathogen characterization, agricultural disease research, and biosurveillance genomic analysis.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA Evo 2 model via BioNeMo NIM, high-memory GPU nodes for genomic inference, bioinformatics pipeline integration.

blueprints.name: Generative Protein Binder Design Pipeline Blueprint
blueprints.description: Multi-stage generative AI pipeline for designing protein binders — combines AlphaFold2 structure prediction, RFdiffusion conformation exploration, and ProteinMPNN sequence generation to design therapeutic molecules faster.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Orchestrates a sequence of BioNeMo NIM microservices — AlphaFold2 for target structure prediction, RFdiffusion for binder conformation generation, ProteinMPNN for sequence design — to design protein therapeutics that bind a target protein. The pipeline is 5x faster than CPU equivalents and compresses months of traditional trial-and-error into a computational workflow.

detail_in_practice.default: Drug discovery teams use this pipeline to computationally design protein binders for a target — narrowing a near-infinite sequence space down to testable candidates before expensive wet lab synthesis.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Biopharma and biotech teams design novel antibody-like binders, peptide therapeutics, and protein drugs computationally — getting to synthesis-ready candidates in days rather than months of iterative lab work.
detail_in_practice.education: Academic medical centers and research universities use this pipeline for translational research — giving faculty access to frontier protein design AI tools for grant-funded therapeutic discovery programs.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs (AlphaFold2, RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN), high-memory GPU nodes for molecular simulation, protein structure visualization pipeline.

blueprints.name: Generative Virtual Screening Pipeline Blueprint
blueprints.description: Generative AI pipeline for designing and screening optimized small molecule drug candidates — combines protein structure prediction, molecular generation, and docking to accelerate early-stage drug discovery.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Chains BioNeMo NIM microservices — OpenFold2 for protein structure prediction, GenMol for drug-like molecule generation, DiffDock for binding pose prediction — to design small molecule drug candidates optimized for a specific protein target. Applicable to any protein target, not just reference cases.

detail_in_practice.default: Drug discovery teams use generative virtual screening to design optimized small molecule candidates computationally — replacing early-stage screening of large compound libraries with AI-generated, target-optimized candidates.
detail_in_practice.healthcare-life-sciences: Pharma and biotech teams run generative virtual screening against novel targets to produce optimized lead candidates for synthesis — compressing hit identification from months to days.
detail_in_practice.education: Research universities run generative virtual screening pipelines for academic drug discovery programs — enabling faculty and graduate students to pursue computational hit identification without access to large compound libraries.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs (OpenFold2, GenMol, DiffDock), GPU-accelerated molecular docking, high-memory GPU nodes, chemistry informatics pipeline integration.

blueprints.name: Build Your Own Transaction Foundation Model Blueprint
blueprints.description: Create intelligent transaction embeddings using transformer architecture trained on tabular financial data — enabling fraud detection, personalization, risk scoring, and behavioral analytics from raw transaction sequences.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Trains a transformer model on sequences of tabular transaction data — producing rich behavioral embeddings that capture spending patterns, account relationships, and behavioral signals. The resulting foundation model can be fine-tuned for fraud detection, customer personalization, credit risk, AML, and other downstream tasks specific to the organization.

detail_in_practice.default: Financial institutions use transaction foundation models to build a proprietary behavioral intelligence layer — embeddings trained on their own data that outperform generic models on every downstream task.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Banks and payment processors train transaction foundation models on their own card, ACH, and wire data — producing embeddings that power proprietary fraud models, personalization engines, and risk scoring.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State revenue and benefits agencies train transaction models on benefits disbursement, tax payment, and procurement data — powering fraud detection that understands their own population and payment patterns.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Retailers train transaction models on purchase history to power proprietary recommendation, loyalty, and loss-prevention systems — behavioral intelligence trained on their own customers.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NeMo for transformer training, GPU cluster for training (H100/B200), tabular data preprocessing pipeline, fine-tuning framework for downstream tasks.

blueprints.name: Quantitative Signal Discovery Agent Blueprint
blueprints.description: Automate and scale the discovery, testing, and refinement of trading signals for quantitative research — AI agent systematically explores signal hypotheses, backtests candidates, and surfaces the most promising for researcher review.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Deploys an AI agent that autonomously generates signal hypotheses from market data, executes backtests, evaluates statistical robustness, and refines candidates — compressing the signal research cycle that would otherwise require weeks of manual quant researcher effort.

detail_in_practice.default: Quantitative research teams use this agent to scale signal discovery — running systematic exploration of the signal space in parallel rather than sequentially, surfacing candidates for researcher review rather than generation.
detail_in_practice.financial-services: Hedge funds and quant asset managers deploy signal discovery agents to explore alpha hypotheses at scale — the agent does the systematic search, quant researchers evaluate and refine what surfaces.

blueprints.detail_infrastructure: NVIDIA NIM LLM, NeMo Agent Toolkit, Nemotron reasoning model, backtesting engine integration, market data pipeline, GPU-accelerated computation.

blueprints.name: Content Localization Blueprint
blueprints.description: Localize and translate media content at scale — translates audio and video, syncs speaker lip movements to translated audio, and preserves speaker identity across languages for broadcast, streaming, and enterprise content.
blueprints.detail_what_it_does: Automatically translates spoken audio in video content, synthesizes translated speech preserving the original speaker voice, and applies lip-sync to match the translated audio to the speaker on screen — enabling professional-quality localization at a fraction of traditional dubbing cost and time.

detail_in_practice.default: Marketing and communications teams use this to localize video content across languages without manual dubbing — training materials, product demos, and corporate communications reach global audiences at scale.
detail_in_practice.education: Universities and e-learning platforms localize course video content across languages — making lectures, tutorials, and educational materials accessible to international students without manual translation projects.
detail_in_practice.retail-distribution: Retailers localize product video content, training materials, and marketing across regional markets — the same product demo reaches multiple language markets without reshooting.
detail_in_practice.state-local-government: State agencies localize public-facing video communications — emergency instructions, benefits guidance, and civic information — for multilingual communities without per-language production budgets.
